located_observations.observation: Long curved shade and two supports lead into title; a full lamp dominates left, open book spans lower edge, and an ochre diagonal hatch plane bridges the lamp and right reading plane.

Forest-green wide arched shade, warm underside, two continuous supports joining shade and oval base are visible together. Entire product is uncropped.
Directional cuts follow curved shade, book/page and diagonal light planes. Dense speckle remains on large ink masses; body strokes are clean on unhatched paper.

style.observation: Forest-green/ochre relief print; crisp shade silhouette and intersecting lit book/page planes carry composition.

substantive_visual.observation: Complete structural lamp and multiple lit book/page shapes occupy and organize the composition; nonglyph content is substantive.

excluded_template.observation: The shade crosses into the title zone, ochre light plane and open-book edges interlock across the whole image. This is an image-led print arrangement, though copy has condensed into too-small lines.

product_identity.observation: Full product visible with preserved deep forest-green color, wide curved horizontal shade, paired joined supports and oval base; supplied background/position was not protected.

hangul.observation: Native serif body has coherent syllable proportions and open counters; fine strokes lose body presence after 720px reduction. Word spaces are visible, title cut-ink strokes remain legible.

function_contact.observation: Two supports visibly attach to shade and shared base; base rests on desk/book-plane setting. No hand or person contact requested.

information_relationship.observation: Descriptions are adjacent in one group; event/date/place below; visit and URL nearby. Enlargement should preserve this route.

material_edges.observation: Plate-like boundaries and intentional directional hatching maintain the print genre. No visible warped product join or accidental crop.
